title: plan.do.see persistence contract v2
description: A data dictionary and relationship contract, not a validation schema for database row objects.

calendar_dates.rule: No timezone conversion for date-only values

execution_times.rule: Store UTC; display in Asia/Seoul or browser locale with explicit label

overdue.rule: status != done AND due_date < current calendar date in Seoul

fields.title: text
fields.from_reflection_id: uuid nullable; logical link to pds_reflections.id

rules: Snapshot and plan update occur in a single database transaction via pds_update_plan
Soft delete: deleted_at does not physically delete child records
Only nondeleted tasks count toward plan metrics
Execution logs do not overwrite the plan or task estimated time
Blocker count is unique task count with at least one nonblank blocker
Primary key prevents duplicate completion event per task
Current completed count uses task.status, not event count
pds_create_next_plan creates next plan once and links it to the reflection

aggregation.planned: count(pds_tasks where plan_id matches and deleted_at is null)
aggregation.overdue: count(filtered_tasks where status!='done' and due_date < Seoul today)
aggregation.blocked: count(distinct task_id where any linked log has nonempty trimmed blocker)
aggregation.evidence: Clickable metric reveals linked tasks; time metric opens time details which links to task execution records

security.mutations: Vercel server function with service-role credentials
security.publicAccessWarning: No login. All API-backed data is public via the app; anyone can also mutate it.
